verdict.rationale: Remote documents pulling payroll data out to your systems via its API (remote-docs-2), and a CLI that downloads payslips and exports any list to CSV/JSON for scripts (remote-docs-20, remote-docs-21). Agent tooling (MCP server, agent skills) lets an agent fetch data and export reports (remote-docs-15, remote-docs-17, remote-docs-18), but nothing shows payroll journal entries specifically or reconciliation into a ledger. missing for 10: documented payroll journal / general-ledger export endpoint, accounting-system or ledger reconciliation integration, payroll-specific MCP read tools or agent skill, independent hands-on corroboration.
